description: Atomically apply a staging session's files to the live site. Runs preflight + secret/malware scan against the complete staged set; on failure the session stays open and can be re-attempted or aborted. For replace-mode against a site with existing files, requires confirm:"I-want-to-replace-all-files".

confirm.description: Required only for replace-mode commits against a site that already has files. Pass exactly "I-want-to-replace-all-files" to acknowledge that the live files will be deleted and replaced with the staged set.

delete.description: Patch-mode only: site-relative paths to remove from the live site as part of this commit. Useful for renames (write new path via add_files, delete old path here).

dryRun.description: If true, preview what commit would do without touching the live site or scratch dir. Returns the diff (filesDeployed, deletedFiles) plus would-be confirmation gate / preflight outcomes. Skips the secret/malware scan to keep the preview fast — the real commit will still scan. Recommended before any replace-mode commit on a populated site.

name: commit_deploy

customHeaders.description: Result of the Netlify-style _headers sync: overrides applied to the site's response headers, plus any validation warnings.

dryRun.description: True if this was a dry-run; nothing was committed.

title: Commit a staged deploy
